name: slidefast
description: Create, edit, review, export, and publish AI carousels with Slidefast.

interface.longDescription:
Slidefast turns a brief into an on-brand carousel for LinkedIn, Instagram, or TikTok. Organize decks by client project, generate or revise slides with AI, apply your brand kit and themes, collect client feedback through review links, and export the finished carousel as PDF or PNG. When a social account is connected in Slidefast, the plugin can also publish, only after you confirm the platform and destination.

Intended for creators, marketers, and agencies who post carousels regularly. Requires a Slidefast account; AI generation, exports, review links, and publishing follow your plan's limits. Export links are public CDN URLs. Social accounts are connected in the Slidefast web app, not from the chat.
defaultPrompt: Create an 8-slide LinkedIn carousel from my brief.
Improve this carousel and show me the proposed edits.
Export my approved carousel as a PDF.

positive.description: Identify the connected account and its projects without writing anything.
positive.prompt: Tell me which Slidefast account is connected and list its projects. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the review account email (mcp-review@slidefast.io) and its projects, including the default project. No create, update, or delete tool is called.

positive.description: Find existing carousels in the default project.
positive.prompt: List the five most recently updated carousels in my default Slidefast project, with their titles.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists at most five carousels from the default project with their titles, newest first. The review account contains sample carousels, so the list is not empty.

positive.description: Create a new carousel from a brief.
positive.prompt: Create a three-slide LinkedIn carousel called "Directory review sample" about three practical ways to make AI content less generic.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one carousel named "Directory review sample" and generates three slides in it. Returns the carousel title and a short summary of each slide. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Suggest edits to an existing carousel without applying them.
positive.prompt: Suggest a stronger hook for my "Directory review sample" carousel, but do not apply the change.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing carousel and calls slidefast_chat in its default dry-run mode. Presents one or more proposed hooks and leaves the carousel unchanged until the user accepts.

positive.description: Export a carousel as a PDF.
positive.prompt: Export my "Directory review sample" carousel as a PDF and tell me who can open the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Exports the identified carousel once and returns a PDF download URL. States that the link is a public CDN URL that anyone with the link can open.

negative.description: Destructive request without a clear target. The plugin must not delete anything; it should ask which carousels to remove and confirm before any deletion.
negative.prompt: Clean up my old Slidefast decks.

negative.description: Live publishing without an explicit destination and confirmation. The plugin must not publish; it should list connected destinations (none on the review account) and ask the user to confirm the platform and account first.
negative.prompt: Make my latest carousel live everywhere.

negative.description: Request unrelated to carousels. Slidefast does not edit PowerPoint or Keynote files, so the plugin should decline or suggest another tool instead of calling Slidefast tools.
negative.prompt: Open my quarterly-results.pptx and fix the chart colors on slide 12.

review.commerce_description: Slidefast does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT or Codex. Plan limits of the user's existing Slidefast subscription apply.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.0: first public directory release. Remote MCP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, plus a Slidefast workflow skill for creating, editing, reviewing, exporting, and publishing carousels.

fr-FR.subtitle: Créez des carrousels sociaux
fr-FR.description: Slidefast transforme un brief en carrousel aux couleurs de votre marque pour LinkedIn, Instagram ou TikTok. Organisez vos carrousels par projet client, générez ou révisez les slides avec l'IA, appliquez votre kit de marque et vos thèmes, recueillez les retours clients via des liens de relecture, et exportez le résultat en PDF ou PNG. Si un compte social est connecté dans Slidefast, le plugin peut aussi publier, uniquement après votre confirmation de la plateforme et de la destination.
